attchmntText: GVP Infotech Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: GVP Infotech Limited approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 20, 2026. The company reported a loss after tax of 235.55 lakhs for the quarter. Revenue from operations was 20.46 lakhs. The company acquired 51% of Esaas Technologies Private Limited on August 10, 2026, for 220,00,000 rupees. The Board also approved the conversion of 1,97,82,690 partly paid-up equity shares into fully paid-up shares. Total assets stood at 13,072.71 lakhs as of September 30, 2026. Equity share capital was 3,666.78 lakhs. The auditor issued a clean review report with no material misstatements noted.

attchmntText: GVP Infotech Limited has informed the Exchange about conversion of 5,73,066 (Five Lakh Seventy-Three Thousand Sixty-Six) partly paid-up equity shares into fully paid-up equity shares, upon receipt of the First and Final Call Money.
voiceSummary: GVP Infotech Limited reports the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 17th November, 2026. The Board approved the conversion of 5,73,066 partly paid-up equity shares into fully paid-up equity shares. This action followed the receipt of First and Final Call Money aggregating to Rs. 28,65,330. The payment period for this call money ran from 5th October, 2026 to 3rd November, 2026. The company had previously issued Reminder-cum-Forfeiture Notices on 30th September, 2026. The reconciliation statement indicates that 1,97,82,690 shares were converted on 24th July, 2026. An additional 5,73,066 shares were converted on 16th November, 2026. The total partly paid-up shares for which in-principle approval was obtained is 2,11,72,007. The meeting took place at the registered office in New Delhi. The announcement was signed by Director Dhaval Jitendrakumar Mistry, DIN 03411290.

attchmntText: GVP Infotech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 17, 2026.
